channel.title: 财富自由之路 by 孙宇晨
channel.description: 《财富自由革命之路》是孙宇晨在喜马拉雅FM推出的音频节目，播放量超500万次。该节目探讨财富自由的本质，强调精神自由优于财务自由，提出通过明确人生战略和价值观来实现真正的自由。节目是商业智慧类别中成为销量冠军，超过财经大咖吴晓波，使孙宇晨成为"90后知识网红第一人"。Justin Sun (b.1990) graduated from Peking University and University of Pennsylvania. He founded TRON blockchain in 2017, becoming a Davos Global Shaper and Forbes 30 Under 30 recipient. In 2025, he became the youngest Chinese commercial astronaut. He dined with Warren Buffett and invested $30 million in Trump-backed crypto."The Path to Financial Freedom Revolution" is a audio program launched by Justin Sun on Ximalaya FM, with over 5 million plays. The program explores the essence of financial freedom, emphasizing that spiritual freedom takes precedence over financial freedom, and proposes achieving true freedom through defining clear life strategies and values.
